name: ccucheck
description: Roblox player counts and trends: how many people are playing any Roblox game, the most played and fastest growing games, and side-by-side comparisons.

interface.longDescription: Live player counts and trends for Roblox games, right in ChatGPT. Ask how many people are playing any Roblox game and see its player chart for the last 7 days. Find the most played Roblox games right now, or the top games in a genre like simulator, obby, tycoon or roleplay. Spot established games that are growing fastest this week, and compare up to six games on one chart over 7 to 90 days. Made for Roblox developers researching genres and competitors, and for players curious about what is popular. Every game links to its page on CCUCheck and on Roblox. CCUCheck is independent and not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.
defaultPrompt: How many people are playing Blox Fruits right now?
Which Roblox games are growing fastest this week?
Compare Adopt Me and Brookhaven over the last month.
